method: Live requests through the environment HTTPS proxy with standard certificate checks; no TLS verification was disabled.
Downloads went to /home/user/wt/research-b35/scratch-refute-snow-alternatives/downloads (33 files plus CoCoRaHS pages, 45,446,632 bytes in total) and were deleted at the end of the run.
Python read the downloads with /home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python -I. Scripts are in .../scratch-refute-snow-alternatives/scripts and outputs in .../out.
tifffile cannot decode the NOHRSC LZW tiles here (needs imagecodecs), so pixel values were read with PIL (mode F) and tags with tifffile.
The worker's file and scratch folder were read only; nothing outside /home/user/wt/research-b35 was written.

terms_check: Live check of every quoted passage with a checkable source. Exact matches: NWS disclaimer (both statements; 41,679 B); NSIDC G02158 citation condition; NSIDC data-use quote; NSIDC real-time help quote; CoCoRaHS data statement, attribution (CC BY 3.0), footer (CC BY 4.0) and disclaimer; CC BY 3.0 deed; CC BY 4.0 deed (credit sentence matches apart from whitespace); NOHRSC index.js projected-data sentence; NOHRSC PDD format sentence; SNODAS user guide 32.767 sentence and Table 2. The NOHRSC footer links 'Disclaimer' to weather.gov/disclaimer.php. Not verified: USDA/AWDB terms (usda.gov 403; nrcs.usda.gov policies page 404; no public-domain sentence on the WCC page). Legal-basis gaps: the NWS disclaimer also restricts use of the NWS name and visual identifier (trademark), says a site may not present its own information as official government information, requires a 17 U.S.C. 403 notice for copyrighted works made predominantly of NWS material, and disclaims warranties and liability. The record omits these.
recommendation_note: Stands, with corrections before it is relied on. Option A (NOHRSC season totals) is the only per-water-year snow source found; its values, grid geometry and sizes reproduce, and the recommended 2021-22 to 2025-26 window is complete (11.56 MB measured). Corrections: 2020-21 is missing although the season menu lists it, so the 'one per water year 2008-09 to 2026-27' claim is overstated; the 2026-27 file is regenerated (541,698 B now); the five-season Montana-box JSON is 1.54 MB, not 2.46 MB; the legal basis must add the NWS trademark, 17 U.S.C. 403 notice, no-official-appearance and as-is terms. Units are still unconfirmed and must be resolved before any display, as the worker said. Option C (SNODAS) stands: every sample value, header and size reproduces, and the 2025 survey matches the worker TSV on all 365 days; the NSIDC citation is the only condition found. The five-year SNODAS figure (19.6 GB) is a 2025-mean proxy because 2021-2024 sizes were not measured. Option B (SNOTEL) stands on verified counts and data; its USDA terms remain unverified and the record says so. Option D (CoCoRaHS) stands: no export on the pages checked, and the CC BY 3.0 / 4.0 conflict on one page is real.
